Departure prep on a relaxed morning
Staff will learn what is expected
Companion Animal Travel Desk
Purpose: this section explains how we care for traveling pets and keep each handoff calm and clear.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk supports guests who travel with pets by checking travel papers, confirming kennel fit, and noting any feeding or comfort needs before departure. Staff should speak gently, keep the counter tidy, and move pets and carriers with steady attention. If a pet seems uneasy, the team should slow the exchange, keep voices low, and alert the cabin team so the animal is watched closely during flight. Records must stay accurate and easy to read, and any change in routing, carrier condition, or special care should be shared with the next person on duty at once.

When a traveler arrives, staff should listen carefully, review the booking details, and explain the next step in simple language. If a pet arrives in poor condition, or the carrier does not meet airline rules, the desk should pause the trip and bring in the senior coordinator. Clean hands, kind words, and prompt notes help Aurelia Skyways keep the process safe and reassuring for everyone involved. Contact the senior coordinator for any unclear case or concern.
